desc:
Welcome to Power RNG, a combat game where skill turns into pure luck! play in and let’s see if you’ll be a nobody… or maybe a god-complex dominating the server.

What does Power RNG have?

[🌳] A Skill Tree to upgrade your RNG stats.

[🧪] A shop where you can buy potions to make getting powerful powers easier.

[🧤] Gloves that boost your stats!

[🛡️] Gadgets that grant you passive skills!

[📊] Leaderboards showing who’s the best based on kills or rolls, maybe you’ll make it into the tops 100!

[🎲👊] Roll over +56 unique powers.

Codes 👀⭐:

- 50KVISITS
- MYTHIC

[⚠️] You need to join the group to redeem them

[❗] This game may contain some bugs and issues due to its recent release.
